validation.retained_reports: All 24 reports pass measure_node_graph_browser.mjs validateReports; cold fallbacks are zero. Trial schedules and all published summary medians are independently recomputed from retained samples.

fixture: Unmodified paired-grid-v1: 100 nodes / 500 connections and 500 nodes / 2000 connections, 35% zoom, 1440x900 CPU viewport. Twenty samples per distribution and twenty alternating pointer release/idle cycles per process run.

commands.browser: CHROME_BIN='/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome' WASM_BINDGEN_TEST_RUNNER=<runner> ROUTING_BROWSER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=45 node scripts/measure_node_graph_browser.mjs <copied-release-test.wasm>

methodology: Each experiment uses three paired process runs per variant per platform. Pair order is fixed before sampling and includes both baseline-first and candidate-first runs. Native runs precede browser runs; each browser run uses a fresh isolated Chrome process/profile. Executables are immutable copies. No concurrent Cargo builds/tests/clippy during timing runs. Summaries are medians of three per-run p50 or p95 values, not pooled percentiles or confidence intervals. All complete retained runs are included.
assertions: Each timing invocation passes both routing performance tests. Reference fixtures require zero cold/release/settled fallbacks, complete release rebuilds, complete idle reuse, stable topology, and cold/history-aware correctness. The production band-order helper also has independent original-sort oracle tests comparing final f32 bits for empty, duplicate, unique, shuffled, reversed, sorted, and float-boundary inputs. Work-budget spending sites and candidate iteration order are unchanged.
collection_note: One initial v2 browser invocation exited successfully, but the outer collector attempted to parse progress output as JSON and lost that report. The full preselected v2 browser schedule was restarted with the collector locating the final JSON report, before inspecting any v2 browser timing. It is not included or described as retained evidence.

baseline.description: Original stable f64-distance sort with f32 total-coordinate tie-breaker, then numeric dedup at both route_bundle call sites.

experiments.decision: Not selected: native cold and release costs show no consistent material improvement.
experiments.candidate: Same distance comparator and dedup order; only sort_by replaced by sort_unstable_by in a private shared helper.

limitations: CPU widget fixture only: no GPU submission, native application composition, capture services, or end-to-end presentation latency. Aligned rows contain repeated coordinates; timings do not establish gains for arbitrary unique-band layouts. Stationary and following-idle costs are not the optimization target. The large fixture remains above a 16.67 ms frame budget. Three process pairs are descriptive evidence, not a tail-latency guarantee.
